title: Authentication-Results prepend copies entire message body (up to 25 MiB)
description: session.rs: 'let mut prefixed = header_line.into_bytes(); prefixed.extend_from_slice(&raw_bytes); raw_bytes = prefixed;'. For a 25 MiB message, this is a full 25 MiB allocation + copy on every auth-enabled delivery. In the hot path of every inbound message. Expected impact: with 100 concurrent connections each delivering a large message, this is ~2.5 GiB of transient allocation. Fix: carry the header separately as a Vec<u8> alongside raw_bytes through the pipeline, and prepend only when writing to the final destination (queue or store::deliver).
